title: Robin's Rescue

expected_payload.comparison: Pinned ScummVM 2026.3.0 SLUDGE detector and exact ScummVM robinsrescue.zip payload

reason: The author's current itch.io page still publishes the original v1.0 platform archives and identifies data/robins_rescue.slg as the game data file. This audit compares that author-hosted release payload to the exact binary identity used by ScummVM without executing either archive.
